a_before_b.rationale: Adapter-based finetuning is a parameter-efficient training technique for transformer models, while RAG architecture concerns the structural integration of retrieval and generation components; understanding RAG does not require knowledge of how adapters modify transformer layers.

b_before_a.rationale: RAG architecture describes a system-level design for combining retrieval with generation, which is independent of the specific fine-tuning method used to adapt a generator model, so mastering RAG is not required to understand adapter-based finetuning.
